headline: How Higher Sales, Lower EPS And New Guidance At McKesson (MCK) Has Changed Its Investment Story
summary: On August 5, 2026, McKesson Corporation reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results showing sales of US$105.38 billion, higher than a year earlier, while net income and earnings per share from continuing operations declined year-on-year. Alongside these results, McKesson completed a large portion of its long-running share repurchase program and raised adjusted earnings guidance, highlighting management’s confidence in specialty and oncology growth, technology and AI investments, and the...
